title: Bass Safe and Sound
lyrics:
Yeah.
Just let it sit right there.
Don’t rush it. Let it breathe.
Let the time stretch out.

[Verse 1]
Let the bass be late
So I can relate
Off beat, nice and neat
Bass safe and sound
Down here on the ground
We don’t need to push the clock
We just let the rhythm rock
Step back from the metronome
Let the low-end find its home
Dragging just a fraction, gaining the traction
No sudden reaction, just pure satisfaction
The snare is crisp but the kick is loose
Pouring out that midnight juice
Let the bass be late
So I can relate.

[Pre-Chorus]
(Synthesizer swells softly in the background, echoing)
You feel the rush of the world outside
But in this room, we just let it glide
The frequency drops, the tension clears
Melting away the frantic years
There’s a pocket of space between the kick and the snare
And we are just floating, suspended right there.

[Chorus]
Off beat, nice and neat
Bass safe and sound
When the world spins fast, we slow it down
Keep it heavy, keep it round
In the empty spaces, truth is found
Let it lag, let it drag, let the timeline break
For the heavy low-end and the time we take
Bass safe and sound.
Safe and sound.

[Verse 2]
Look at the grid, watch the transients fall
I don’t want it quantized, I want the crawl
A human touch in the digital wire
Sparking up a slow-burn fire
Let the hi-hat skip, let the rimshot delay
We’re not in a hurry, we’ve got nothing to say
Just feeling the weight of the woofer’s hum
Waiting for the delayed beat to come
Let the bass be late
So I can relate
To the stumble, the rumble, the beautiful flaw
The unwritten rhythm, the unspoken law.

[Bridge]
(Beat strips away entirely. Only a low, rhythmic pulse remains. Echoing vocals)
Hold the line.
Stretch the time.
Find the groove inside the rhyme.
It’s not a mistake, it’s a conscious choice
Giving the silence its own voice.
Let it swing. Let it sway.
Let the heavy frequencies play.

[Instrumental Break - Dub Section]
(Heavy tape delay effects on the snare drum)
(Sub-bass becomes massive, rolling in waves)
(Syncopated electric piano chords echoing into infinity)
(Deep, rhythmic breathing sounds blended with the vinyl crackle)

[Verse 3]
Back in the pocket, deep in the trench
Turning the groove with a phantom wrench
Tightening the loose ends, loosening the tight
Everything feels so impossibly right
Let the bass be late
So I can relate
When it finally hits, it’s a physical blow
A slow-motion impact, a steady glow
Nothing is rigid, nothing is locked
The foundation is solid but the structure is rocked
Off beat, nice and neat
The ultimate rhythmic retreat.

[Extended Pre-Chorus]
You feel the rush of the world outside
But in this room, we just let it glide
The frequency drops, the tension clears
Melting away the frantic years
There’s a pocket of space between the kick and the snare
And we are just floating, suspended right there.
We’re hacking the clock, rewriting the code
Taking the long way, the scenic road.

[Chorus]
Off beat, nice and neat
Bass safe and sound
When the world spins fast, we slow it down
Keep it heavy, keep it round
In the empty spaces, truth is found
Let it lag, let it drag, let the timeline break
For the heavy low-end and the time we take
Bass safe and sound.
Safe and sound.

[Verse 4]
Fifty milliseconds behind the line
But in my mind, the timing is fine
It’s the swagger, the strut, the confident pace
The absolute mastery of the sonic space
Let the bass be late
So I can relate
It’s the pulse of the earth, the shift of the tide
The ultimate groove where the shadows hide
We don’t chase the tempo, we let it come to us
Riding the back of this midnight bus.

[Spoken Word / Breakdown]
(Music fades to just a muted bassline and a snapping finger)
Listen to the silence.
The silence isn't empty. It's full of anticipation.
You expect the note to drop here...
(Pause)
But it drops here.
And in that fraction of a second, that microscopic delay, that's where the soul lives.
That's where the human element survives the machine.
Late. Relatable. Safe. Sound.

[Final Chorus]
(Everything kicks back in at maximum warmth and volume)
Off beat, nice and neat
Bass safe and sound
When the world spins fast, we slow it down
Keep it heavy, keep it round
In the empty spaces, truth is found
Let it lag, let it drag, let the timeline break
For the heavy low-end and the time we take
Bass safe and sound.
Safe and sound.

[Outro]
Let it be late.
Let it relate.
Nice and neat.
Off the beat.
(Bassline begins to slowly degrade into a low rumble)
Safe and sound.
Down on the ground.
(The kick drum stops)
(The hi-hat stops)
(Just the sub-bass fading out, holding the last note for thirty seconds, blending into the vinyl crackle until it slowly fades into absolute silence)
[End]
